eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Clark; Butte; Bingham; Power; Oneida; Jefferson; Fremont; Madison; Teton; Bonner; Bannock; Caribou; Franklin; Bear Lake; Cassia; Blaine, ID; at 2:31 PM on AUG 1, 2025 Effective until 4:31 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an activation of the Endangered Missing Person Alert system. The Bannock County Sheriff's Office 208-236-7111 is looking for a missing person who was last seen in the Mink Creek Rd. area of Pocatello ID and is believed to be in danger. Linda Zweigart is a 67 year old female 5ft 7in tall 182lbs with brown hair and brown eyes. Authorities say that the missing person may be traveling in a Grey 2017 Hyundai Tucson Idaho Plate 10EDT. If you have any information on the where abouts of this missing person please contact 9  1  1 immediately.
